name: rsdl
information_for_contributors: Keyword list source of truth: crates/ridl-syntax/src/keywords.rs (RSDL_KEYWORDS).
An .rsdl file holds the five rsdl declarations over the typl file structure, so
this grammar includes the typl patterns it shares by reference (source.typl#...)
rather than copying them. What it adds is the eight rsdl keywords of rsdl reference
§2 (system component distribution deployment machine offers requires for) and the
attribute block of rsdl §5, with its rsdl-owned keys and its `namespace.key`
backend keys. Update this grammar and keywords.rs together when the registry changes.

keywords-line.comment: rsdl §4 — the keyword of a component line.
keywords-line.name: keyword.other.line.rsdl

keywords-clause.comment: rsdl §3.4 — the relation clause of a deployment.
keywords-clause.name: keyword.other.clause.rsdl

attributes.comment: rsdl §5 — the attribute block after a name or at the end of a line.

backend-key.comment: rsdl §5 — a backend key, two camelCase names around a dot, carried uninterpreted.

owned-key.comment: rsdl §5 — the rsdl-owned keys and the family keys `labels` and `deprecated`.
owned-key.name: variable.other.property.rsdl
